description: Get your first glimpse of gameplay from the upcoming first-person horror game Black Lake, in which you search for your missing twin sister inside an abandoned orphanage lost at sea. It's in development for PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4928600/Black_Lake/
